paite: Singgi sing in halmang thillat maitam abawl a; adunglam tong nga ahi a, availam tong nga ahi a, huan asanlam tong thum ahi. Kiptak a bawl ahi.
heading: Thillatte Halna Maitam Bawlna / (Eks 27.1-8)

paite: Aning lite ah akii abawl a; akiite akibang vek ua; dal in aluan hi.
Atui-um belsuan tengteng, maitam, belte, vutluahte, salu kuangte, sa thuknate leh meibel tengteng dal in abawl hi.
Huan alaizangtak nuai ah among dang ah dal hakvang maitam a ding in abawl hi.
Chiangte omna ding in, dal hakvang mong lite a ding in sikkual li asung hi.
Singgi sing in zawl abawl a, dal in aluan hi.
Azawnna ding in, maitam pang a sikkualte sung ah zawlte athunlut a; maitam singpek in asung ahawmsak hi.
Dal in tuikuang leh akhe abawl a, numei nasem, kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak a kikhawmte' limlangte abawl hi.
heading: Dal Tuikuang Bawlna / (Eks 30.18)

paite: Huangsung abawl a; simlam pang simlam ah huangsung puankhai, puanmalngat hoih koptah, tong zakhat a-om hi.
heading: TOUPA Omna Puanin Huangsung / (Eks 27.9-19)

paite: Akhuamte sawmnih ahi ua, adal kingakna khuakkuakte sawmnih; khuam bannate leh adangka puanduangte a-om uhi.
Amallam pang a ding in puankhaite tong zakhat ahi ua, akhuamte uh sawmnih leh adal kingakna khuakkuakte sawmnih; akhuamte abannate leh dangka gaknate.
Atumlam pang a ding in tong sawmnga a sau puankhaite a-om ua, akhuamte sawm leh akingakna khuakkuak sawm; akhuamte abannate leh adangka gaknate a-om uhi.
Asuahlam pang suahlam a ding in tong sawmnga.
Kongpi sik khat a puankhaite tong sawm-le-nga ahi ua; akhuamte thum, akingakna khuakkuakte thum mah.
Hiai lam leh huai lam, huangsung kongpi sik khat lam pang a ding in puankhai tong sawm-le-nga ahi ua; akhuamte thum, akingakna khuakkuakte thum mah ahi.
Huangsung akimvel a puankhai tengteng puanmalngat koptah hoih ahi.
Khuam kingakna khuakkuakte dal ahi ua; khuam bannate leh adangka gaknate dangka azingte uh luanna; huangsung khuam tengteng dangka in agaknate akibawl hi.
Huangsung kongpi a puankhai phim a khui, khau dum, khau sandup, asan-au leh puanmalngat hoih koptah ahi. Adunglam tong sawmnih ahi a, apek sanlam tong nga ahi, huangsung puankhaite toh akituak hi.
Akhuamte li ahi a, akingakna khuakkuakte li, dal a bawl ahi. Abannate dangka a bawl, dangka a bawl azingte leh adung luante.
Biakbuk kilhna zum teng leh huangsung kimvel kilhna tengteng dal ahi uh.
Hiai biakbuk vankim, sim a om bang in, theihpihna biakbuk ate ngei, Levite nasepna dia, Mosi thupiak bang zel a siampu Aaron tapa, Ithamar khut a bawl ahi uhi.
heading: TOUPA Omna Puanin Lamna Sik Vanzatte

paite: Huchi in Bezaleel, Uri tapa, Hur tapa, Judah nam a mi in TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak tengteng abawlta hi.
Amah toh sem, gelh nasep siam, khau dum leh khau sandup leh khau san-au leh puanmalngat a zebawl siam, Aholiab, Ahisamak tapa, Dan nam a mi ahi.
Dangka-eng tengteng mun siangthou a nasepna teng a sepna dia zat, thillat dangka-eng nangawn, talent sawmnih-le-kua leh shekel, mun siangthou a shekel dungzui in, zasagih-le-sawmthum ahi.
Dangka, khawmpi a simte mun siangthou a shekel dungzui in talent zakhat leh shekel sangkhat zasagih sawmsagih-le-nga ahi.
Michih a ding in beka khat, huai bel, shekel kimkhat ahi, mun siangthou a shekel dungzui in, michih sim a omte a ding in, kum sawmnih a upa leh atunglam, pasal nuaiguk sangthum zanga-le-sawmnga.

Dangka talent zakhat mun siangthou a kingakna khuakkuak a ding in asung ua, puanzak a kingakna khuakkuakte toh; talent zakhat a dia kingakna khuakkuak zakhat, kingakna khuakkuak khat a dia talent khat zel.
Shekel sangkhat zasagih sawmsagih-le-nga in khuam bannate abawl a, azingte luan in akimatsak hi.
Thillat dal talent sawmsagih leh shekel sangnih-le-zali ahi.
Huaite in kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak kingakna khuakkuak abawl a, dal maitam leh dal hakvang a bawl, maitam tui-um belsuan tengteng toh.
Huangsung kimvel a kingakna khuakkuak, huangsung kongpi kingakna khuakkuak, biakbuk kilhna zum tengteng leh huangsung kimvel a kilhna zum tengteng azou hi.
